title: New Shell Integration PowerToy: Copy as UNC

proposed_comments.title: Align the sparse-package external location and manifest paths

confidence.rationale: The pinned source passes the module directory as the external location, while the manifest executable and installed executable are in different directory roots; the paths are directly verifiable, though installation behavior has not been run.

proposed_comments.body:
### Align the sparse-package external location and manifest paths

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:**
`src/modules/CopyAsUNC/CopyAsUNCExt/PowerToysModule.cpp` (`enable()`), `src/modules/CopyAsUNC/CopyAsUNCContextMenu/AppxManifest.xml`, and the `CopyAsUNCContextMenu` output/install layout.

**Problem:**
`enable()` passes `get_module_folderpath(globals::instance)` to `RegisterSparsePackage` as the external location. The manifest's `Executable="PowerToys.exe"` and COM class path are resolved relative to that location. The context-menu binaries are emitted under `WinUI3Apps`, while the installer places `PowerToys.exe` in the parent install directory, so those paths do not describe one consistent external root.

**Why it matters:**
The package can resolve its executable or COM server against the wrong directory, preventing the shell command from activating on the installed layout. This is a source-level path mismatch; I have not reproduced an installation or activation failure.

**Suggested change:**
1. Choose one external root and align every manifest path and output/install rule with it. For the current layout, register the package with the install root as `ExternalLocationUri` and set the COM class path to `WinUI3Apps\\PowerToys.CopyAsUNCContextMenu.dll`; alternatively, keep the module-folder root and ensure both the executable and COM server are present at the manifest-relative paths. Keep the package MSIX URI separate from the chosen external root.

**Verification:**
Build and install an x64 package, inspect the registered sparse-package external location, confirm that both the executable and COM path resolve to files there, and invoke Copy as UNC for a mapped network drive.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: A complete repair must coordinate the registration root, manifest-relative executable/COM paths, and packaged output layout; a single-file code suggestion would be incomplete.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the CopyAsUNC package version in step with PowerToys

confidence.rationale: The exact-head helper compares package major/minor/revision with product constants, while the pinned release version script updates peer package manifests but omits CopyAsUNC; the repeated-registration path is source-derived, not runtime-observed.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the CopyAsUNC package version in step with PowerToys

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:**
`src/modules/CopyAsUNC/CopyAsUNCContextMenu/AppxManifest.xml`, `.pipelines/versionSetting.ps1`, and the version comparison in `src/common/utils/package.h` called from `src/modules/CopyAsUNC/CopyAsUNCExt/PowerToysModule.cpp`.

**Problem:**
`IsPackageRegisteredWithPowerToysVersion()` compares the registered package's major, minor, and revision with PowerToys' version constants, and `enable()` uses that check before registration. The CopyAsUNC manifest remains at `1.0.0.0`, but `versionSetting.ps1` updates the PowerRename, ImageResizer, FileLocksmith, and NewPlus context-menu manifests without updating CopyAsUNC.

**Why it matters:**
For a normal build whose product version differs from `1.0.0.0`, the package will not satisfy the current-version check, so `enable()` will take the sparse-package registration path again instead of recognizing the package as current. This identifies a version-contract mismatch; it does not establish an observed install failure.

**Suggested change:**
1. Add `CopyAsUNCContextMenu/AppxManifest.xml` to the version-setting pipeline and set `Package.Identity.Version` from the same generated version used for the other context-menu packages, preserving the expected four-part package version.

**Verification:**
Run the version-setting step with a representative product version and assert that the CopyAsUNC manifest matches the other context-menu package versions; then verify that the registered package version passes `IsPackageRegisteredWithPowerToysVersion()` for that build.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required change belongs in the shared release-version pipeline as well as this newly added manifest, so an isolated manifest or pipeline suggestion would not be a complete coordinated fix.
